service_boundary: Represents api.x.ai, not the Grok consumer applications, X, Grok Build, individual model releases, or Grok served through another cloud platform.
regional_controls: The reviewed public API documentation centers on global endpoints; enterprise regional arrangements require contract review.
retention_controls: By default API requests and responses are retained for 30 days for abuse auditing and are not used for training without permission. Team-level Zero Data Retention is available with documented exclusions for stateful, file, collection, and batch features.
routing: Customers choose Grok models and optional xAI-operated tools; the service does not route across independent inference providers.
customization: The public API emphasizes model and tool invocation rather than imported customer weights.
strengths: Direct API access to Grok models and xAI-operated web and X search tools.
Self-service Zero Data Retention behavior is documented.
tradeoffs: The catalog is limited to xAI-operated models and tools.
Zero Data Retention disables several stateful API features.
